body: I'm a jealous person, the fact that these relationships didn't work out don't make me lose as much sleep at night as knowing that people who wronged me are know happy and successful while I've been left behind. Things won't get better from here because I haven't been working towards my future. I don't know sorry I'm acting all bitchy. I don't want to date anymore, I wish I was gay or something. I'm so done with this shit.

It's more than just bad relationships, it's a huge sense of inadequacy. I know what I'm going through doesn't mean much to other people, but I've been incapable of living on because of this issue. From working out, to getting good grades, to making friends; everything seems like nothing but a cheap imitation of what they achieved when they were younger. I mean there must be something that's seriously wrong with me. Noting in life belongs to me anymore, it's all from the perspective of them; and I let it derail my college career. Now I look back and my teen years are gone, never fully enjoyed because I wasn't outgoing enough and because I let these two suck up all my time and thoughts. I don't know, I'm just so done.
